verdict.rationale: Shared component and style libraries are a fair axis for a design tool like Canva, so this is not "na". The pack only shows adjacent features. Brand Templates can be made accessible to teams, and brand kits can be accessed via MCP. Nothing documents publishing reusable components or styles across files, or controlled propagation of updates when the source changes.

support.subject: As a designer, shared libraries publish components and styles across files and projects, with controlled updates when the source changes
